messages:
Maya: Quick microcopy question on the rollout confirmation modal — current header says 'Stop rollout' and the body is just 'Are you sure?'. Feels abrupt. Anyone have wording ideas?

Alex: I noticed that too. Also the modal doesn't explain what happens to in-flight requests or traffic routing.

Maya: Proposed change: swap 'Stop rollout' -> 'Pause rollout' and add a short explanatory line about routing, e.g. 'Pausing will route new requests to the previous stable version; in-flight requests may continue.' Thoughts?

Sam: +1 to 'Pause' — less scary. But users skim, so keep the explanation single sentence and short.

Leo: Maybe rephrase to be even tighter: 'Pause rollout — new requests go to the previous version. Active requests may finish.' Short, scannable.

Alex: UX nit: make sure button hierarchy reflects intent. Primary CTA should be 'Pause rollout' (destructive-ish) and secondary 'Cancel'. Also suggest an inline link to docs if people want details: /docs/rollouts#pause

DesignBot: Lint/AX check: 'Pause' is a good tone. Accessibility: ensure modal title receives focus and add aria-describedby linking to the explanatory sentence. Also confirm contrast on the primary button when it's a destructive action.

Maya: Updated copy proposal (for engineering/figma):
```
{
  "title": "Pause rollout",
  "body": "Pausing routes new requests to the previous stable version. Active requests may still complete.",
  "primary": "Pause rollout",
  "secondary": "Cancel"
}
```
(keeping body short so it reads in a single glance)

Sam: Minor preference: drop repeated word 'rollout' in button? i.e., just 'Pause' vs 'Pause rollout'. I lean toward fuller label in case of ambiguous context, so 'Pause rollout' ok.

Leo: Another idea — add a tooltip on the rollout status pill that says: 'Paused — new requests are routed to previous version' so users who see the state get the same messaging later.

Alex: Sounds good. Can someone update the Figma copy and push the new strings to components/copy? /cc @Product for visibility.

Maya: Will update Figma and open a small PR for the copy strings. Thanks all :thumbsup:
